news.title: STAT+: Gilead to pay $45 million to settle kickback charges filed by Texas attorney general
news.summary: Gilead Sciences agreed to pay $45 million to settle allegations of paying kickbacks that improperly influenced prescriptions paid for by the Texas Medicaid program

news.title: STAT+: Detailed data confirm Moderna and Merck cancer vaccine met key endpoints in melanoma trial
news.summary: A Moderna and Merck personalized mRNA cancer vaccine reduced the risk of disease recurrence in patients with melanoma by 42% compared to standard treatment.

news.title: STAT+: AbbVie skin disorder drug succeeds in late-stage trial, but results miss market expectations
news.summary: AbbVie's lutikizumab, an experimental therapy for a chronic skin condition, succeeded in a late-stage trial but missed market expectations.

news.title: STAT+: Nutrition experts press White House to release ultra-processed food definition
news.summary: MAHA allies and nutrition experts want the Trump administration to act on ultra-processed foods before the elections.

news.title: Top MAHA adviser Calley Means resigns from White House days ahead of midterms
news.summary: The surprising departure of Calley Means comes just before an election that may serve as a referendum on the MAHA movement.

news.title: STAT+: Will the Treasury restrict U.S. investment in the Chinese biotech sector?
news.summary: Rumors are swirling that the Treasury Department this week is going to propose a rule that restricts U.S. investment in the Chinese biotech sector.

news.title: STAT+: Crackdowns loom, from China to New York
news.summary: Speaking on the economy, the vice president told a crowd in Ohio that, “You don’t turn the Titanic around overnight.” Send news tips and bad metaphors to John.Wilkerson@statnews.com or John_Wilkerson.07…

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about a U.S. rule on Chinese deals, Belgium refusing Mounjaro coverage, and more
news.summary: U.S. is poised to issue a proposed rule that would subject outbound licensing deals with Chinese biotech companies to additional scrutiny

news.title: STAT+: What to expect from the Moderna-Merck cancer vaccine data reveal
news.summary: The Moderna-Merck cancer vaccine data reveal is days away. Here's what to expect.

news.title: STAT+: FDA finalizes its guidance on apps related to drugs, pharma rejoices
news.summary: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: FDA's guidance on prescription drug use-related software, and telehealth pushing GLP-1s for addiction.

news.title: Health insurance premiums jump 9%, and more Americans don’t have access to coverage
news.summary: Working-age U.S. adults without health insurance rose in 2026. Half of all uninsured people did not seek needed care because of cost concerns, according to a new survey.

news.title: STAT+: Workers are paying 9% more for family health coverage this year, a higher jump than in the recent past
news.summary: A KFF survey finds that rising healthcare costs are squeezing both employers and workers.

news.title: Opinion: What I got wrong about the Affordable Care Act — and how to fix it
news.summary: “The big mistake, ironically, was the ACA’s lack of focus on affordability,” writes Dana Goldman.

news.title: Opinion: The inherited disease my family called ‘it’ had a name, which changed everything
news.summary: For 50 years, doctors shrugged about the disease running through Miranda Pappas’ family. Then she discovered something.

news.title: STAT+: Telehealth leapfrogs FDA approval with off-label GLP-1 prescriptions for addiction
news.summary: As telehealth promotes GLP-1s for addiction, experts worry about fragmented care, and exposing patients to unknown risks.

news.title: Few Americans say CDC, FDA are doing a good job: survey
news.summary: Public confidence in the CDC and FDA has fallen to record lows, with just 26% and 25% of Americans, respectively, rating the agencies’ performance as excellent or good in a Gallup poll.

news.title: Redesign Health, ARC Global merge in $2B deal to accelerate health system innovation
news.summary: The three organizations—Redesign Health, ARC Global and AVIA—work with more than 100 health systems on five continents, and the companies and products built across their networks have reached more than 100 million patients worldwide.

news.title: Uninsured rate climbs to 11.2% in 2026: Commonwealth Fund
news.summary: The uninsured rate has climbed over the past two years as Medicaid work requirements—which are expected to drive their own coverage losses—loom at the beginning of 2027.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—RFK Jr. advisor Calley Means resigns; Premier Health names next CEO
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Molina Healthcare highlights Medicaid bright spots in Q3
news.summary: Molina Healthcare is seeing some bright spots in the Medicaid market heading into 2027, echoing commentary from other payers through several third quarter earnings calls so far.

news.title: Sentara Health deploys new AI case management tool co-developed with Regard
news.summary: Executives say the solution could save nearly 90,000 hours as the system looks to expand across acute care and into ambulatory care.

news.title: Microsoft, Opella partner on agentic AI content verification platform
news.summary: The platform—dubbed Lumen—will consist of 14 agents that can perform an array of tasks, from reviewing content product claims and flagging corrections.

news.title: Optum seeks to have Maryland lawsuit over 'defective' computer system dismissed
news.summary: The state's Attorney General Anthony Brown sued Optum in August, alleging that the company defrauded its Medicaid program in providing a faulty computer system for its behavioral health program.

news.title: Rural Minnesota hospitals' operations are withering. They say 'profiteering' drugmakers, insurers are to blame
news.summary: In a press conference this week, the heads of rural nonprofit hospitals called for immediate lawmaker intervention as financially fatal federal policy changes loom around the corner.

news.title: Talkiatry takes therapy nationwide as it builds out behavioral health platform
news.summary: Talkiatry is expanding virtual therapy services nationwide as part of a broader push to provide comprehensive behavioral health services across the acuity spectrum, from low to high.

news.title: KFF: Employer family premiums up 5% to $28K in 2026
news.summary: Employer family premiums grew yet again in 2026, increasing by 5% to $28,303 on average, according to a new report from KFF.

news.title: Integris Health to join Kaiser Permanente's Risant Health
news.summary: Pending approvals, Oklahoma's largest nonprofit health system will follow in the footsteps of Geisinger Health and Cone Health in seeking outside investment and tech-enabled value-based care know-how from the Kaiser subsidiary.

news.title: Treasury sweeps biotech into proposed COINS Act restrictions, but spares Big Pharma’s China licensing deals
news.summary: Despite the sweeping scope of the ban covering various types of drug molecules, biopharma business development teams can breathe a measured sigh of relief.

news.title: After leak, Merck and Moderna post phase 3 cancer vaccine data early
news.summary: Merck & Co. and Moderna have shared highly anticipated phase 3 data on their cancer vaccine ahead of schedule, revealing a primary endpoint hit that approached analysts’ best-case scenario. But the positive result was offset by weaker-than-expected data on a key secondary endpoint.

news.title: Menarini's Stemline picks up Georgiamune preclinical cancer immunotherapy in $1.1B deal
news.summary: Georgiamune, an immunology-focused biotech out of Maryland, has licensed a preclinical cancer drug candidate to Stemline Therapeutics, owned by Italy's Menarini Group, for up to $1.1 billion.

news.title: AbbVie scratches out phase 3 hidradenitis suppurativa win but falls short of expectations
news.summary: A phase 3 trial of AbbVie’s lutikizumab in hidradenitis suppurativa has hit its primary endpoint. But with the drug candidate beating placebo by a narrower margin than expected, the readout raises questions about AbbVie’s chances of cracking a competitive market.

news.title: Celltrion picks up another Kaigene autoimmune antibody for up to $580.5M
news.summary: Celltrion has licensed a preclinical antibody targeting autoimmune conditions from Maryland-based biotech Kaigene in a deal worth up to $580.5 million, marking another step in the South Korean drugmaker's expansion beyond its traditional biosimilar business.

news.title: Abbott to separate Nutrition business into an independent, publicly traded company
news.summary: Abbott will separate its Nutrition business into an independent, publicly traded company through a tax-free distribution to Abbott shareholders.

news.title: Quest Diagnostics’ test results system breached in yet another medtech cyberattack
news.summary: Quest Diagnostics is the latest life sciences company to fall victim to a cyberattack, with the company believing patient records have been compromised.

news.title: Rebranded NodThera plans IPO to fund NLRP3 inhibitor’s push toward approval
news.summary: NodThera—under its new name Rezera—is planning an IPO as the biotech steps up its ambitions to get its NLRP3 inhibitor to market.

news.title: Roche’s CEO has ‘absolutely not’ changed tune on Poseida despite scrapping CAR-T from the buyout
news.summary: Roche’s CEO has insisted to Fierce that the company’s view on its $1.5 billion Poseida buyout has “absolutely not” changed, even as the Swiss pharma scraps one of the CAR-T therapy’s from the acquisition.

news.title: ‘A two-way conversation with the tumor’: Researchers use ‘avatar’ to predict immunotherapy responses
news.summary: Researchers have explored a revolutionary way to predict a patient's response to immunotherapies by creating a tumor “avatar” from biopsies.

news.title: Amid bepirovirsen triumph, GSK quietly scraps trial of next-gen hep B therapy
news.summary: GSK may have cemented its hepatitis B credentials with Tuesday’s landmark FDA nod for its “functional cure” bepirovirsen, but the pharma continues to rethink its strategy for next-gen candidates.

news.title: Roche builds blockbuster BTK case for fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis as FDA decision approaches
news.summary: Roche has dived into the data behind its filing for FDA approval of fenebrutinib in multiple sclerosis, unpacking the BTK inhibitor’s effect on chronic active lesions, disease control and brain volume.

papers.title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
papers.summary: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. papers.title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
papers.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks. We introduce RoboCasa-Shift, a diagnostic robustness benchmark built on RoboCasa365 that combines controlled single-factor shifts, matched clean-perturbed rollouts in which each pair shares the same underlying settings and differs only in the target shift, and simulator-grounded stage-aware diagnostics. papers.title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
papers.summary: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. Direct finetuning performs best on capability metrics but leads to the most privacy leakage, while DP-SGD reduces leakage at substantial cost to capabilities.
